title: 4D-STEM Analysis of Fe-Sulfides from the Early Solar System
content: The chemical and physical origins of our solar system are stored in the solid materials leftover from its birth. Such planetary materials include meteorites, interplanetary dust particles, and samples returned from other bodies such as the Moon, asteroids, and comets. Information on the atomic-scale structure and composition of planetary materials is important for phase identification, and ultimately, to reverse engineer their chemical origins.
